summary: JELCOS iter 151 review. Found and fixed a CRITICAL frontend syntax bug (stray </View> in MilestoneEditor.tsx:215) that was breaking Metro web bundling and rendering the entire app blank (SyntaxError: Adjacent JSX elements must be wrapped). After fix, bundle compiles and login + admin/collab-auth + tools/collaborate all render. Backend: 8/8 new tests PASS for /api/collaboration/auth-config (public + admin GET/PUT with 401 when unauth) and /api/collaboration/sessions/{id}/otp/send + /otp/verify (email send 200 via Resend, 60s throttle returns 429, wrong code returns 401 'Incorrect code', invalid channel 400, unknown session 404). Seeded one TEST contact + 'TEST OTP Session' for super@test.com to enable session-scoped OTP tests. Frontend: /admin/collab-auth screen renders correctly with the 'Advanced verification methods' Switch (default OFF), green banner 'Advanced methods are OFF (recommended). Initiators see WhatsApp OTP and/or Email OTP — and may skip verification entirely.', plus 'Default: One-Time Passcode (OTP)' card with WhatsApp OTP and Email OTP chips. DigiLocker NOT shown on Collaborate screen with advanced OFF (verified at runtime). Deep-dive panel & milestone Go-deeper verified via code review (DecisionContinuePanel.tsx — header 'Want to go deeper? Explore this in another module', flexWrap row, default modules list excludes 'swot'; MilestoneEditor.tsx — per-row 'Go deeper' TouchableOpacity expands DecisionContinuePanel inline with sourceModule='goal-setter'). Note: 'Collaboration Verification' card is under the (collapsed by default) 'Plans, Tiers & Segments' group on /admin home — code (admin/index.tsx:62,70) is correct; just expand the group to see it.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the silent UI failure: a duplicate </View> on MilestoneEditor.tsx line 215 (introduced when wiring the new milestone deep-dive panel). Babel parser surfaced 'Adjacent JSX elements must be wrapped in an enclosing tag' which Metro converted to a hard bundle failure; the served HTML still loaded but the JS bundle never executed, so the whole web app rendered as a blank #root. Removing the stray closing tag (only one opening <View key={m.milestone_id} style={st.row}> exists for that row) restored the bundle and unblocked all flows.
